Folks — ran preliminary pricing. If we do a temporary H100 band for ~3 weeks attached to the Dedicated reservation, the marginal unit rate for the band (given current inventory) is ~1.95x of the standard reserved H100 unit. With a 7.5% overage cap across tokens that yields a predictable delta that Lumen can accept.

- Need legal to sign a short amendment and procurement to confirm invoice timing.

Forwarding Lumen's ask into the exec queue. Quick summary and ask for leadership:
- Customer: LumenHealth (strategic healthcare customer, mid-enterprise)
- Request: temporary H100-only band for 10/15–11/05 attached to their Dedicated reservation.
- Commercial asks: capped overage at 7.5% (tokens), preemption credit, one-off amendment.
- Why approve: preserves long-term reserved revenue, prevents production degradation during an important clinical launch, high expansion probability if successful.

Proposal for sign-off: CEO/Revenue ops (or delegated exec) approval to offer the transient band with the terms below — Karthik has priced it; Markus to confirm capacity allocation. If approved, legal will issue the amendment and procurement signs.

Proposed terms (short):
1) Term window: 2027-10-15 to 2027-11-05
2) Transient band: 8 H100-equivalent devices (details in Docsend)
3) Overage: capped at 7.5% of reserved baseline tokens billed at transient unit rate
4) Availability credit: 4% credit to Lumen invoice if availability SLA for the band is missed by >2 hours cumulatively
5) Billing: one-off invoice for the band pro-rated for the window; standard net-30

Can we get an approval (or objections) by EOD tomorrow so I can get amendment drafted?

— Priya

Priya / team — I confirm capacity-wise this is doable with a small re-lift of the H100 pool for that window; ops will reserve it conditionally once legal and finance sign off. Two operational caveats:
- We need a hard start timestamp and a soft shutdown procedure (automated drain + traffic reroute) to avoid token loss at decommission.
- If Lumen requests an earlier start (<72 hours notice) we will need an expedited provisioning fee.

I support the proposed 7.5% overage cap and the 4% SLA credit as reasonable mitigations. From infra POV, preemption credit is operationally implementable per-request as a token refund.

Markus
